currentParagraphText: “No,” Nature’s Attendant said in a stern voice. “They were not. And that’s the true cause for concern. Yip of Yore was impatient. He had barely lived for a full era before he foolishly tried to kill the Malefic Viper of all gods. Now, imagine if Yip had been smarter. What if he had waited for another era? Five more? What if he had honed himself and fully realized his Path before aiming for the throne? If he had... things could have gotten dangerous. Very dangerous.”
